fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xayah''' enters a frenzy for 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} to be empowered to fire an additional smaller feather at the target {{tip|on-hit}} that deals 25% damage of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}.
fields.description2: Whenever '''Xayah''' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with the strike, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
fields.description3: ''If {{ci|Rakan}} is nearby upon cast, he also becomes empowered, and gains the {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} at the same time as '''Xayah'''.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
